title: Roost v2 — full rewrite
items: New TypeScript coordinator (H3 + Kysely + node:sqlite) replaces legacy Rust coord
Event-sourced sessions: every state change is an append-only event folded by the same pure function in both coord and browser
Single Solid createStore root — all sidebar views read one store, no per-domain wedges
Browser connects directly to worker over authenticated WSS — coord is out of the PTY byte path
Tailscale-first networking: workers register their tailnet hostname; browser reaches them directly
EdDSA JWT auth via WebCrypto — private key lives in IndexedDB, never sent to coord
Theme persistence: light / dark / auto follows prefers-color-scheme and survives reload
Coordinator health banner: offline or coord-unreachable state surfaced inline without a full reload
wterm-only terminal: raw stream-json rendering, no xterm, no overlays
Structured OMP bridge coverage from session start through transcript recovery
